fact: On 5 October 2026 Niger's authorities announced imminent commissioning of the fibre interconnection with Algeria, which complements the southern link to Benin (ACE, SAT-3) and the axis to Nigeria (MainOne, SAT-3, ACE, Glo-1, WACS, Equiano, NCSCS).
title: Interconnexion avec l’Algérie : le Niger accélère son désenclavement numérique
